method: Direct inspection of version-pinned public repository source, build files, tests, and licenses after the Scrapling source acquisition. No private source was accessed.

public_haskell_comparison.disposition: Useful independent implementation evidence, but not a complete oracle for the frozen 277-vector Moriarty gate.

official_java_core_boundary.disposition: Do not bypass access controls. Do not require the private Java core. Use it only as optional, authorized, version-pinned differential evidence if it later becomes available.

license_boundary.technical_specification_dictionary_tests: These public repositories use CC BY-SA 4.0 at the inspected commits. Preserve attribution and share-alike duties where applicable.
license_boundary.public_service_webapp_riskservice: The inspected public software repositories use Apache-2.0 notices.
license_boundary.core_license: ACTUS Core License 1.0 imposes conditions on modified core software and assertions of conformance. Obtain legal review before distribution or any conformance claim.
prohibited_claims: universal equivalence to unavailable private code
license_boundary.note: This is a research disposition, not legal advice.

prompt_design_consequences: Make all 277 public vectors mandatory with no skips, exclusions, quarantines, or expected failures.
Compare every ordered result field present in a fixture and preserve decimal intent without binary32 downcasts.
Implement all 18 executable types as typed packages over shared language abstractions and the shared compiler pipeline.
Require one evidence-backed disposition for each of the 32 taxonomy rows without inflating executable coverage.
Use the private Java core only as optional authorized evidence.
Call the result ACTUS reference-vector compatibility, not certification.
limitations: The 277 fixtures are a finite regression corpus and do not prove all combinations or universal financial correctness.
Repository observations apply only to the pinned commits.
No official private Java core source or executable result was inspected.
